notes: The roadmap requires battery and altitude checks but does not state thresholds.
These values are explicit synthetic development assumptions, not legal limits, hardware specifications, or safety guarantees.
Restricted-area checks use a straight-line center-to-center route baseline against circular or polygonal blocked map records.
The 20 m inter-drone separation threshold is a synthetic software-simulation assumption, not a hardware specification.
Collision avoidance, weather, communications, and physical flight dynamics are not evaluated by this policy.
